question: Which of the following states emerged as a separate state in 1963?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nagaland was formed on the 1st of December 1963.**
 
• It was separated by Assam.
